conditions.name_zh: 中樞型睡眠呼吸中止症
conditions.summary_zh: 睡眠時因腦部呼吸驅動暫時失常而反覆停止或減弱呼吸，與上呼吸道阻塞型不同。
conditions.summary_en: A sleep-related breathing disorder in which brain respiratory drive repeatedly pauses or weakens, distinct from upper-airway obstruction.
conditions.western_context_zh: 睡眠時因腦部呼吸驅動暫時失常而反覆停止或減弱呼吸，與上呼吸道阻塞型不同。
conditions.western_context_en: A sleep-related breathing disorder in which brain respiratory drive repeatedly pauses or weakens, distinct from upper-airway obstruction.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 呼吸控制中樞未能持續向呼吸肌發出訊號，造成氣流與呼吸努力同步下降。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Respiratory control centers intermittently fail to signal the breathing muscles, reducing airflow and respiratory effort together.
conditions.etiology_zh: 呼吸控制中樞未能持續向呼吸肌發出訊號，造成氣流與呼吸努力同步下降。
conditions.etiology_en: Respiratory control centers intermittently fail to signal the breathing muscles, reducing airflow and respiratory effort together.

risk_factors_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

risk_factors_zh.factor: 心臟衰竭或中樞神經疾病
risk_factors_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

risk_factors_zh.factor: 鴉片類藥物或高海拔暴露
risk_factors_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

risk_factors_en.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

risk_factors_en.factor: Heart failure or central neurologic disease
risk_factors_en.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors
NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

red_flags_zh.finding: 清醒時呼吸困難、胸痛或發紺
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為嚴重低氧或心肺急症
red_flags_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

red_flags_zh.finding: 嗜睡已影響駕駛安全或出現昏厥
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 停止駕駛並接受當日醫療評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 未控制的睡眠呼吸障礙會造成即時安全風險
red_flags_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

red_flags_en.finding: Breathing difficulty while awake, chest pain, or cyanosis
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency evaluation immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate severe hypoxemia or an acute cardiopulmonary problem
red_flags_en.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

red_flags_en.finding: Sleepiness affecting driving safety or syncope
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Stop driving and obtain same-day medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: Uncontrolled sleep-disordered breathing creates an immediate safety risk
red_flags_en.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 僅可輔助處理失眠、緊張或治療相關不適，不可取代睡眠檢查、正壓通氣或病因治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能矯正睡眠時呼吸驅動或取代呼吸支持。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 確認呼吸狀態穩定；嚴重嗜睡、低氧或未治療心衰時不進行常規門診針灸。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與睡眠醫學、心臟科或神經科共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May only support insomnia, tension, or treatment-related discomfort; it cannot replace sleep testing, positive-airway-pressure therapy, or treatment of the cause.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot correct sleep-related respiratory drive or replace ventilatory support.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Confirm respiratory stability; defer routine outpatient acupuncture with severe somnolence, hypoxemia, or untreated heart failure.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with sleep medicine, cardiology, or neurology.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NHLBI — Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

sources.title: Sleep Apnea — Causes and Risk Factors

conditions.summary_zh: 一組由發育中腦部異常或損傷造成的永久性動作、平衡與姿勢障礙；功能表現與共病差異很大。
conditions.summary_en: A group of permanent movement, balance, and posture disorders caused by abnormal development of or injury to the developing brain; function and comorbidities vary widely.
conditions.western_context_zh: 一組由發育中腦部異常或損傷造成的永久性動作、平衡與姿勢障礙；功能表現與共病差異很大。
conditions.western_context_en: A group of permanent movement, balance, and posture disorders caused by abnormal development of or injury to the developing brain; function and comorbidities vary widely.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 非進行性的腦部病灶會影響運動控制，但肌骨併發症與功能限制可隨成長改變。
conditions.western_pathology_en: A nonprogressive brain disturbance affects motor control, while musculoskeletal complications and functional limitations can change with growth.
conditions.etiology_zh: 非進行性的腦部病灶會影響運動控制，但肌骨併發症與功能限制可隨成長改變。
conditions.etiology_en: A nonprogressive brain disturbance affects motor control, while musculoskeletal complications and functional limitations can change with growth.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 發育中腦部感染、出血或損傷

risk_factors_en.factor: Preterm birth or low birth weight
Infection, bleeding, or injury affecting the developing brain

red_flags_zh.finding: 新出現或進行性無力、功能退化
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 數日內由神經科或兒科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 腦性麻痺本身非進行性，退化須查其他原因

red_flags_zh.finding: 癲癇持續、呼吸或吞嚥困難
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能危及呼吸道或代表癲癇重積

red_flags_en.finding: New or progressive weakness or functional regression
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain neurologic or pediatric assessment within days
red_flags_en.rationale: Cerebral palsy itself is nonprogressive, so regression requires another cause to be assessed

red_flags_en.finding: Prolonged seizure, breathing difficulty, or swallowing difficulty
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May threaten the airway or represent status epilepticus

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可作痙攣相關疼痛、睡眠或照護壓力的輔助處理；不可宣稱修復腦損傷或取代復健。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能修復既有腦損傷、逆轉腦性麻痺或取代復健。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 依溝通、感覺敏感、攣縮、骨密度與癲癇狀況調整體位和刺激量。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與兒科／神經科、物理／職能／語言治療及照護者共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support spasticity-related pain, sleep, or care stress; it must not be presented as repairing brain injury or replacing rehabilitation.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot repair established brain injury, reverse cerebral palsy, or replace rehabilitation.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Adapt positioning and stimulation to communication needs, sensory sensitivity, contractures, bone health, and seizure status.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with pediatrics/neurology, physical/occupational/speech therapy, and caregivers.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 耳垢堆積至造成症狀或妨礙耳道與鼓膜檢查的狀態，可引起耳悶、聽力下降、耳鳴或耳痛。
conditions.summary_en: Accumulation of cerumen that causes symptoms or prevents examination of the canal and tympanic membrane; it may cause fullness, hearing loss, tinnitus, or pain.
conditions.western_context_zh: 耳垢堆積至造成症狀或妨礙耳道與鼓膜檢查的狀態，可引起耳悶、聽力下降、耳鳴或耳痛。
conditions.western_context_en: Accumulation of cerumen that causes symptoms or prevents examination of the canal and tympanic membrane; it may cause fullness, hearing loss, tinnitus, or pain.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 耳垢生成、外移與清除失衡，或被棉棒、助聽器等推入深處而阻塞耳道。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Cerumen production, outward migration, and clearance become imbalanced, or wax is pushed deeper by swabs, hearing devices, or other objects.
conditions.etiology_zh: 耳垢生成、外移與清除失衡，或被棉棒、助聽器等推入深處而阻塞耳道。
conditions.etiology_en: Cerumen production, outward migration, and clearance become imbalanced, or wax is pushed deeper by swabs, hearing devices, or other objects.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 狹窄或形狀異常的耳道

risk_factors_en.factor: Narrow or anatomically altered ear canal

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發單側聽力喪失、眩暈或神經症狀
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 當日耳鼻喉或急診評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 不能把突發性感音神經性聽損誤認為耳垢

red_flags_zh.finding: 耳流膿、出血、劇痛或發燒
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 停止自行處理並儘速就醫
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能有感染、外傷或鼓膜問題

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden unilateral hearing loss, vertigo, or neurologic symptoms
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day ENT or emergency assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: Sudden sensorineural hearing loss must not be mistaken for wax

red_flags_en.finding: Ear drainage, bleeding, severe pain, or fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Stop self-treatment and seek prompt medical care
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate infection, trauma, or tympanic-membrane disease

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不能移除耳垢；至多輔助處理緊張，不得延誤耳鏡檢查與安全清除。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能軟化、沖出或器械移除阻塞耳垢。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不在耳道內操作；若疑鼓膜穿孔、耳管、感染或既往耳部手術，避免自行沖洗。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 轉介基層醫療或耳鼻喉科確認診斷並清除。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture cannot remove impacted wax; at most it may support anxiety and must not delay otoscopy or safe removal.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot soften, irrigate, or instrumentally remove impacted cerumen.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not manipulate the ear canal; avoid unsupervised irrigation when perforation, tubes, infection, or prior ear surgery is possible.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Refer to primary care or ENT for confirmation and removal.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 子宮頸表面細胞的癌前異常，通常依活檢分為 CIN 1–3；不是癌症，但高級別病變可能進展。
conditions.summary_en: Precancerous abnormality of cervical surface cells, generally graded CIN 1–3 on biopsy; it is not cancer, but high-grade disease can progress.
conditions.western_context_zh: 子宮頸表面細胞的癌前異常，通常依活檢分為 CIN 1–3；不是癌症，但高級別病變可能進展。
conditions.western_context_en: Precancerous abnormality of cervical surface cells, generally graded CIN 1–3 on biopsy; it is not cancer, but high-grade disease can progress.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 持續高危型 HPV 感染可導致子宮頸細胞逐步出現異型與上皮內病變。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Persistent high-risk HPV infection can drive progressive cellular atypia and intraepithelial lesions of the cervix.
conditions.etiology_zh: 持續高危型 HPV 感染可導致子宮頸細胞逐步出現異型與上皮內病變。
conditions.etiology_en: Persistent high-risk HPV infection can drive progressive cellular atypia and intraepithelial lesions of the cervix.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 持續高危型 HPV 感染
risk_factors_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

risk_factors_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_zh.finding: 性交後或不明原因陰道出血
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速婦科評估，不以針灸處理出血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除侵襲癌或其他婦科病因
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_zh.finding: 追蹤活檢或切除治療逾期
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 儘速聯絡婦科完成風險分層與處置
red_flags_zh.rationale: 高級別病變可能進展且常無症狀
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_en.finding: Postcoital or unexplained vaginal bleeding
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain prompt gynecologic assessment; do not treat the bleeding with acupuncture
red_flags_en.rationale: Invasive cancer or another gynecologic cause must be excluded
red_flags_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

red_flags_en.finding: Overdue biopsy follow-up or excisional treatment
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact gynecology promptly for risk stratification and management
red_flags_en.rationale: High-grade lesions can progress and are often asymptomatic
red_flags_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不能治療或清除 CIN／HPV；僅可處理檢查或手術前後的焦慮、疼痛等輔助症狀。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能清除高危型 HPV、逆轉 CIN 或預防癌症進展。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不得針刺活動性出血或感染區；術後依婦科限制調整。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 必須由婦科依 HPV、細胞學與活檢結果持續追蹤。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Cannot treat or clear CIN/HPV; it may only support anxiety, pain, or other symptoms around evaluation and procedures.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot clear high-risk HPV, reverse CIN, or prevent cancer progression.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle through active bleeding or infection; follow post-procedure gynecologic restrictions.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Ongoing gynecologic follow-up based on HPV, cytology, and biopsy findings is required.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NCI — HPV and Pap Test Results: Next Steps after an Abnormal Test
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 妊娠中期子宮頸可能在缺乏明顯宮縮下提早縮短或擴張，增加晚期流產與早產風險。
conditions.summary_en: Premature cervical shortening or dilation in mid-pregnancy, often without clear contractions, increasing risk of late miscarriage and preterm birth.
conditions.western_context_zh: 妊娠中期子宮頸可能在缺乏明顯宮縮下提早縮短或擴張，增加晚期流產與早產風險。
conditions.western_context_en: Premature cervical shortening or dilation in mid-pregnancy, often without clear contractions, increasing risk of late miscarriage and preterm birth.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 子宮頸結構或功能無法在妊娠負荷下維持閉合；診斷依病史、檢查與超音波綜合判斷。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Cervical structure or function fails to remain closed under pregnancy load; diagnosis integrates history, examination, and ultrasound.
conditions.etiology_zh: 子宮頸結構或功能無法在妊娠負荷下維持閉合；診斷依病史、檢查與超音波綜合判斷。
conditions.etiology_en: Cervical structure or function fails to remain closed under pregnancy load; diagnosis integrates history, examination, and ultrasound.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既往無痛性妊娠中期流產或早產
既往子宮頸手術或創傷
先天性子宮或子宮頸異常

risk_factors_en.factor: Prior painless mid-trimester loss or preterm birth

red_flags_zh.finding: 陰道大量流水、出血、規律宮縮或骨盆壓力增加
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即聯絡產科分娩單位接受當日評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為破水、早產或子宮頸進一步擴張

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、惡臭分泌物或劇烈腹痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為羊膜腔感染或其他妊娠急症

red_flags_en.finding: Gush of fluid, bleeding, regular contractions, or increasing pelvic pressure
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact obstetric triage immediately for same-day assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate membrane rupture, preterm labor, or further cervical dilation

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, foul discharge, or severe abdominal pain
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate emergency/obstetric assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate intra-amniotic infection or another pregnancy emergency

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不能加固子宮頸或預防早產；只有產科明確同意時才可輔助處理一般妊娠不適。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能使子宮頸閉合、替代環紮或預防早產。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 疑似宮縮、出血、破水或感染時不治療；避免任何可能刺激子宮活動的處置。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 由高危產科／母胎醫學決定超音波監測、黃體素或環紮等管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture cannot reinforce the cervix or prevent preterm birth; it may support ordinary pregnancy discomfort only with explicit obstetric agreement.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot close the cervix, replace cerclage, or prevent preterm birth.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not treat when contractions, bleeding, membrane rupture, or infection is suspected; avoid any intervention that may stimulate uterine activity.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Maternal-fetal medicine/obstetrics directs ultrasound surveillance, progesterone, cerclage, or other management.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 子宮頸發炎，可表現為膿性分泌物或接觸性出血；常需檢測披衣菌、淋病及其他感染。
conditions.summary_en: Inflammation of the cervix that may cause mucopurulent discharge or contact bleeding; testing for chlamydia, gonorrhea, and other infections is often needed.
conditions.western_context_zh: 子宮頸發炎，可表現為膿性分泌物或接觸性出血；常需檢測披衣菌、淋病及其他感染。
conditions.western_context_en: Inflammation of the cervix that may cause mucopurulent discharge or contact bleeding; testing for chlamydia, gonorrhea, and other infections is often needed.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 感染或非感染性刺激造成子宮頸上皮發炎與脆弱；未治療的性傳染感染可能上行形成骨盆腔炎。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Infectious or noninfectious irritation inflames and friabilizes cervical epithelium; untreated sexually transmitted infection may ascend and cause PID.
conditions.etiology_zh: 感染或非感染性刺激造成子宮頸上皮發炎與脆弱；未治療的性傳染感染可能上行形成骨盆腔炎。
conditions.etiology_en: Infectious or noninfectious irritation inflames and friabilizes cervical epithelium; untreated sexually transmitted infection may ascend and cause PID.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 未使用保險套的新伴侶或多重伴侶
risk_factors_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

risk_factors_zh.factor: 陰道沖洗或持續化學刺激
risk_factors_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

risk_factors_en.factor: New or multiple partners without barrier protection
risk_factors_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_zh.finding: 下腹／骨盆痛合併發燒、噁心或子宮頸舉痛
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 當日評估骨盆腔炎並開始適當治療
red_flags_zh.rationale: 上行感染可能損害生育力或造成全身感染
red_flags_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_zh.finding: 懷孕時出血、疼痛或疑似感染
red_flags_zh.rationale: 妊娠感染與出血需產科風險評估
red_flags_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_en.finding: Pelvic/lower abdominal pain with fever, nausea, or cervical-motion tenderness
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day assessment for PID and appropriate treatment
red_flags_en.rationale: Ascending infection can harm fertility or cause systemic illness
red_flags_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

red_flags_en.finding: Bleeding, pain, or suspected infection during pregnancy
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact obstetric care the same day
red_flags_en.rationale: Infection and bleeding in pregnancy require obstetric risk assessment
red_flags_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 針灸不能清除感染；可在抗感染處置後輔助處理疼痛或焦慮，但不可延誤檢測與伴侶管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能根除感染、替代抗生素或完成伴侶治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性感染、發燒或未明出血時暫緩；不在發炎生殖器區域操作。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與婦科／性健康服務共同管理，確保檢測、抗生素及伴侶處置。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Acupuncture cannot clear infection; after infectious management it may support pain or anxiety but must not delay testing or partner management.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot eradicate infection, replace antibiotics, or provide partner treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Defer with acute infection, fever, or unexplained bleeding; do not needle inflamed genital tissue.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gynecology/sexual-health services for testing, antibiotics, and partner management.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: CDC — Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

sources.title: Urethritis and Cervicitis — STI Treatment Guidelines

conditions.summary_zh: 由頸椎或頸部軟組織病變轉移至頭部的次發性頭痛，通常與頸部活動受限或特定動作誘發相關。
conditions.summary_en: A secondary headache referred from cervical spine or neck soft-tissue pathology, often associated with restricted neck motion or provocation by specific movement.
conditions.western_context_zh: 由頸椎或頸部軟組織病變轉移至頭部的次發性頭痛，通常與頸部活動受限或特定動作誘發相關。
conditions.western_context_en: A secondary headache referred from cervical spine or neck soft-tissue pathology, often associated with restricted neck motion or provocation by specific movement.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 上頸段結構的傷害性輸入在三叉神經－頸髓複合體匯聚，使疼痛被感知於頭部。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Nociceptive input from upper cervical structures converges in the trigeminocervical complex, producing pain perceived in the head.
conditions.etiology_zh: 上頸段結構的傷害性輸入在三叉神經－頸髓複合體匯聚，使疼痛被感知於頭部。
conditions.etiology_en: Nociceptive input from upper cervical structures converges in the trigeminocervical complex, producing pain perceived in the head.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 持續受限姿勢與頸部負荷

risk_factors_en.factor: Sustained constrained posture and neck loading

red_flags_zh.finding: 雷鳴樣首次劇烈頭痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除蛛網膜下腔出血等危急原因

red_flags_zh.finding: 發燒、癌症史、進行性神經缺損或近期重大外傷
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 停止常規治療並儘速醫療評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為感染、腫瘤、骨折或脊髓／神經病變

red_flags_en.finding: First severe thunderclap headache
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: A critical cause such as subarachnoid hemorrhage must be excluded

red_flags_en.finding: Fever, cancer history, progressive neurologic deficit, or recent major trauma
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Stop routine treatment and obtain prompt medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate infection, tumor, fracture, or spinal/neurologic disease

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可作為已排除危險病因後之疼痛與頸部功能管理的輔助手段；不可用標籤掩蓋其他次發性頭痛。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能在未排除危險次發病因前把頭痛視為單純肌骨疼痛。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 先做神經與頸椎安全篩檢；疑不穩定、骨折、血管病變或脊髓病時避免頸部強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 持續或非典型病例與基層醫療、神經科或物理治療共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May be an adjunct for pain and neck-function management after dangerous causes are excluded; the label must not obscure another secondary headache.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot treat the headache as uncomplicated musculoskeletal pain before dangerous secondary causes are excluded.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Screen neurologic and cervical safety first; avoid strong cervical stimulation when instability, fracture, vascular disease, or myelopathy is possible.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage persistent or atypical cases with primary care, neurology, or physical therapy.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 長期支氣管發炎與黏液過度分泌造成持續咳嗽、痰與呼吸困難，常屬慢性阻塞性肺病表型。
conditions.summary_en: Long-term bronchial inflammation and mucus hypersecretion causing persistent cough, sputum, and breathlessness, commonly a COPD phenotype.
conditions.western_context_zh: 長期支氣管發炎與黏液過度分泌造成持續咳嗽、痰與呼吸困難，常屬慢性阻塞性肺病表型。
conditions.western_context_en: Long-term bronchial inflammation and mucus hypersecretion causing persistent cough, sputum, and breathlessness, commonly a COPD phenotype.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 反覆吸入刺激物引起氣道發炎、杯狀細胞增生、黏液滯留與氣流受限。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Repeated inhalational injury causes airway inflammation, goblet-cell hyperplasia, mucus retention, and airflow limitation.
conditions.etiology_zh: 反覆吸入刺激物引起氣道發炎、杯狀細胞增生、黏液滯留與氣流受限。
conditions.etiology_en: Repeated inhalational injury causes airway inflammation, goblet-cell hyperplasia, mucus retention, and airflow limitation.

red_flags_zh.finding: 靜息呼吸困難、發紺、意識改變或胸痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為嚴重急性惡化、低氧或心肺急症

red_flags_zh.finding: 痰量或膿性突然增加並伴發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為感染性急性惡化

red_flags_en.finding: Breathlessness at rest, cyanosis, altered mental status, or chest pain
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May represent severe exacerbation, hypoxemia, or an acute cardiopulmonary problem

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden increase in sputum volume or purulence with fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate an infectious exacerbation

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可輔助處理穩定期呼吸困難感、焦慮或戒菸支持；不可取代吸入藥、氧療或急性惡化處置。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能逆轉氣流受限、治療低氧或處理急性惡化。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性呼吸窘迫、低氧或感染惡化時不進行常規治療；採能呼吸舒適的體位。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與基層醫療／胸腔科共同管理肺功能、藥物、疫苗與肺復健。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support stable breathlessness perception, anxiety, or smoking cessation; it cannot replace inhaled therapy, oxygen, or exacerbation care.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot reverse airflow limitation, treat hypoxemia, or manage an acute exacerbation.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Defer routine treatment during acute respiratory distress, hypoxemia, or worsening infection; use a breathing-comfortable position.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage pulmonary function, medication, vaccination, and rehabilitation with primary care/pulmonology.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: C 型肝炎病毒持續感染，可多年無症狀但逐步造成纖維化、肝硬化、肝癌與肝衰竭。
conditions.summary_en: Persistent hepatitis C virus infection that may remain asymptomatic for years while progressing to fibrosis, cirrhosis, liver cancer, or liver failure.
conditions.western_context_zh: C 型肝炎病毒持續感染，可多年無症狀但逐步造成纖維化、肝硬化、肝癌與肝衰竭。
conditions.western_context_en: Persistent hepatitis C virus infection that may remain asymptomatic for years while progressing to fibrosis, cirrhosis, liver cancer, or liver failure.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 病毒持續複製與宿主免疫反應造成慢性肝細胞損傷、發炎與纖維化。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Ongoing viral replication and host immune responses drive chronic hepatocyte injury, inflammation, and fibrosis.
conditions.etiology_zh: 病毒持續複製與宿主免疫反應造成慢性肝細胞損傷、發炎與纖維化。
conditions.etiology_en: Ongoing viral replication and host immune responses drive chronic hepatocyte injury, inflammation, and fibrosis.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 1992 年前輸血或未篩檢血液暴露
不安全醫療、刺青或針具暴露

risk_factors_en.factor: Transfusion before 1992 or exposure to unscreened blood
Unsafe medical, tattoo, or needle exposure

red_flags_zh.finding: 吐血、黑便、意識混亂或明顯腹脹
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為肝硬化失代償、出血或肝性腦病

red_flags_zh.finding: 黃疸快速加重、持續嘔吐或右上腹劇痛
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為急性肝損傷或其他肝膽急症

red_flags_en.finding: Hematemesis, black stool, confusion, or marked abdominal distension
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate decompensated cirrhosis, bleeding, or hepatic encephalopathy

red_flags_en.finding: Rapidly worsening jaundice, persistent vomiting, or severe right-upper-quadrant pain
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate acute liver injury or another hepatobiliary emergency

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 只能輔助處理疲勞、噁心或疼痛；不能清除 HCV，也不可延誤可治癒的直接抗病毒治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能清除 HCV、取代直接抗病毒藥或監測肝癌。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 有出血傾向、血小板低下、腹水或失代償肝病時避免深刺與強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與肝病／感染科共同管理抗病毒治療、纖維化與肝癌監測。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May only support fatigue, nausea, or pain; it cannot clear HCV and must not delay curative direct-acting antiviral treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot clear HCV, replace direct-acting antivirals, or provide liver-cancer surveillance.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid deep or strong needling with bleeding tendency, thrombocytopenia, ascites, or decompensated liver disease.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage antiviral therapy, fibrosis, and liver-cancer surveillance with hepatology/infectious disease.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 慢性進行性視神經病變，房角保持開放但眼壓相關損傷可逐步造成不可逆周邊視野喪失。
conditions.summary_en: A chronic progressive optic neuropathy in which the angle remains open but pressure-related injury can cause irreversible peripheral visual-field loss.
conditions.western_context_zh: 慢性進行性視神經病變，房角保持開放但眼壓相關損傷可逐步造成不可逆周邊視野喪失。
conditions.western_context_en: A chronic progressive optic neuropathy in which the angle remains open but pressure-related injury can cause irreversible peripheral visual-field loss.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 房水流出阻力與眼壓相關應力損傷視神經軸突；即使眼壓不高也可能發生。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Resistance to aqueous outflow and pressure-related stress injure optic-nerve axons; disease can also occur without elevated measured pressure.
conditions.etiology_zh: 房水流出阻力與眼壓相關應力損傷視神經軸突；即使眼壓不高也可能發生。
conditions.etiology_en: Resistance to aqueous outflow and pressure-related stress injure optic-nerve axons; disease can also occur without elevated measured pressure.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 黑人／非裔或西語裔族群及糖尿病／高血壓

risk_factors_en.factor: Black/African or Hispanic/Latino ancestry and diabetes/hypertension

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發劇烈眼痛、紅眼、噁心與視力模糊
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能是急性閉角型青光眼而非慢性開角型病程

red_flags_zh.finding: 新出現視野或視力快速惡化
red_flags_zh.rationale: 急性變化不符合典型緩慢病程，需防止不可逆視損

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden severe eye pain, red eye, nausea, and blurred vision
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency ophthalmic care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May be acute angle-closure glaucoma rather than the chronic open-angle course

red_flags_en.finding: New rapid worsening of vision or visual field
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day ophthalmic assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: Acute change is atypical of the slow course and irreversible loss must be prevented

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 不能降低眼壓或阻止視神經損傷；最多輔助處理焦慮、頭頸緊張，不得取代眼藥、雷射或手術。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能降低眼壓、恢復已喪失視野或阻止視神經損傷。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 避免眼球直接施壓及眼眶深刺；任何急性視覺改變先轉診。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 由眼科定期監測眼壓、視神經與視野並調整治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: Cannot lower intraocular pressure or stop optic-nerve injury; at most it may support anxiety or head/neck tension and cannot replace drops, laser, or surgery.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot lower intraocular pressure, restore lost visual field, or stop optic-nerve injury.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid direct pressure on the globe and deep orbital needling; refer any acute visual change first.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Ophthalmology must monitor pressure, optic nerve, and visual fields and adjust treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.summary_zh: 胰臟反覆或持續發炎造成不可逆纖維化，導致慢性腹痛、消化酵素不足、營養不良與糖尿病。
conditions.summary_en: Repeated or persistent pancreatic inflammation causing irreversible fibrosis, chronic abdominal pain, exocrine insufficiency, malnutrition, and diabetes.
conditions.western_context_zh: 胰臟反覆或持續發炎造成不可逆纖維化，導致慢性腹痛、消化酵素不足、營養不良與糖尿病。
conditions.western_context_en: Repeated or persistent pancreatic inflammation causing irreversible fibrosis, chronic abdominal pain, exocrine insufficiency, malnutrition, and diabetes.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 持續損傷啟動發炎與纖維化，逐步破壞胰臟外分泌與內分泌功能。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Ongoing injury drives inflammation and fibrosis, progressively destroying exocrine and endocrine pancreatic function.
conditions.etiology_zh: 持續損傷啟動發炎與纖維化，逐步破壞胰臟外分泌與內分泌功能。
conditions.etiology_en: Ongoing injury drives inflammation and fibrosis, progressively destroying exocrine and endocrine pancreatic function.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 胰管阻塞、高三酸甘油酯或高血鈣

red_flags_zh.finding: 突然加劇的持續上腹痛、反覆嘔吐或發燒
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為急性胰臟炎、感染或阻塞

red_flags_zh.finding: 黃疸、昏厥、低血糖意識改變或消化道出血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為膽道阻塞、代謝急症或出血

red_flags_en.finding: Suddenly worse persistent upper-abdominal pain, repeated vomiting, or fever
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day emergency or medical assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate acute pancreatitis, infection, or obstruction

red_flags_en.finding: Jaundice, syncope, altered mental status from hypoglycemia, or GI bleeding
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate biliary obstruction, metabolic emergency, or bleeding

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可輔助穩定期疼痛、噁心或壓力管理；不可取代酵素、營養、糖尿病與併發症治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能逆轉胰臟纖維化或取代酵素、營養與糖尿病治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 急性劇痛、嘔吐、發燒、黃疸或脫水時不治療；避免在壓痛腹部強刺激。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與胃腸科、疼痛、營養與內分泌團隊共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support stable pain, nausea, or stress management; it cannot replace enzyme, nutrition, diabetes, or complication treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot reverse pancreatic fibrosis or replace enzyme, nutrition, and diabetes treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Defer during acute severe pain, vomiting, fever, jaundice, or dehydration; avoid strong stimulation over a tender abdomen.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with gastroenterology, pain, nutrition, and endocrine teams.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.name_zh: 慢性陰囊內容物疼痛症候群
conditions.summary_zh: 陰囊內容物疼痛持續或反覆，影響日常活動且需排除腫瘤、扭轉、感染、疝氣與轉移痛。
conditions.summary_en: Persistent or recurrent pain localized to scrotal contents that impairs activity and requires exclusion of tumor, torsion, infection, hernia, and referred pain.
conditions.western_context_zh: 陰囊內容物疼痛持續或反覆，影響日常活動且需排除腫瘤、扭轉、感染、疝氣與轉移痛。
conditions.western_context_en: Persistent or recurrent pain localized to scrotal contents that impairs activity and requires exclusion of tumor, torsion, infection, hernia, and referred pain.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 可能涉及術後或外傷神經損傷、感染後敏化、骨盆底肌痛或其他部位轉移痛，部分病例原因不明。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Mechanisms may include postsurgical or traumatic nerve injury, postinfectious sensitization, pelvic-floor myalgia, or referred pain; some cases remain idiopathic.
conditions.etiology_zh: 可能涉及術後或外傷神經損傷、感染後敏化、骨盆底肌痛或其他部位轉移痛，部分病例原因不明。
conditions.etiology_en: Mechanisms may include postsurgical or traumatic nerve injury, postinfectious sensitization, pelvic-floor myalgia, or referred pain; some cases remain idiopathic.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既往輸精管結紮或鼠蹊／陰囊手術
risk_factors_zh.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain
AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

risk_factors_zh.factor: 骨盆底肌痛或慢性骨盆痛
risk_factors_zh.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

risk_factors_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

risk_factors_en.factor: History of scrotal trauma or infection
risk_factors_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

risk_factors_en.factor: Pelvic-floor myalgia or chronic pelvic pain
risk_factors_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

red_flags_zh.finding: 突然單側劇痛、睪丸高位或噁心嘔吐
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診評估睪丸扭轉
red_flags_zh.rationale: 睪丸缺血需緊急處置
red_flags_zh.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

red_flags_zh.finding: 新出現睪丸硬塊、明顯腫脹、發燒或紅斑
red_flags_zh.rationale: 需排除腫瘤、感染或其他急性陰囊病變
red_flags_zh.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden severe unilateral pain, high-riding testis, or nausea/vomiting
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency assessment for testicular torsion
red_flags_en.rationale: Testicular ischemia requires urgent management
red_flags_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

red_flags_en.finding: New hard testicular mass, marked swelling, fever, or erythema
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day urologic/emergency assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: Tumor, infection, or another acute scrotal disorder must be excluded
red_flags_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 完成泌尿科評估後，可輔助處理骨盆底肌痛、神經病理性疼痛與壓力；不可直接假定為肌肉問題。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能在未排除扭轉、腫瘤、感染或疝氣前進行症狀治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不直接針刺陰囊；有急性腫脹、感染、腫塊或扭轉疑慮時禁止治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與泌尿科、骨盆底物理治療及疼痛醫學共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: After urologic assessment, may support pelvic-floor myalgia, neuropathic pain, and stress; it must not be assumed to be muscular without evaluation.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot provide symptom treatment before torsion, tumor, infection, and hernia are excluded.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle the scrotum; defer with acute swelling, infection, mass, or concern for torsion.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with urology, pelvic-floor physical therapy, and pain medicine.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: AUA — Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

sources.title: Diagnosis and Management of Male Chronic Pelvic Pain

conditions.summary_zh: 下肢靜脈瓣膜或回流功能受損造成靜脈高壓，出現腫脹、沉重、皮膚變化與靜脈性潰瘍。
conditions.summary_en: Impaired lower-extremity venous valves or return causes venous hypertension, swelling, heaviness, skin change, and venous ulceration.
conditions.western_context_zh: 下肢靜脈瓣膜或回流功能受損造成靜脈高壓，出現腫脹、沉重、皮膚變化與靜脈性潰瘍。
conditions.western_context_en: Impaired lower-extremity venous valves or return causes venous hypertension, swelling, heaviness, skin change, and venous ulceration.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 瓣膜逆流或靜脈阻塞提高站立時靜脈壓，使液體與發炎介質外滲並逐步損傷皮膚。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Valvular reflux or venous obstruction raises ambulatory venous pressure, promoting fluid and inflammatory leakage and progressive skin injury.
conditions.etiology_zh: 瓣膜逆流或靜脈阻塞提高站立時靜脈壓，使液體與發炎介質外滲並逐步損傷皮膚。
conditions.etiology_en: Valvular reflux or venous obstruction raises ambulatory venous pressure, promoting fluid and inflammatory leakage and progressive skin injury.

red_flags_zh.finding: 單側突然腫痛、發紅或發熱
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 當日評估深部靜脈栓塞
red_flags_zh.rationale: 新發單側症狀可能為血栓而非單純慢性靜脈病

red_flags_zh.finding: 突發呼吸困難、胸痛或咳血
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能為肺栓塞

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden unilateral swelling, pain, redness, or warmth
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Obtain same-day assessment for deep-vein thrombosis
red_flags_en.rationale: New unilateral symptoms may be thrombosis rather than uncomplicated chronic venous disease

red_flags_en.finding: Sudden shortness of breath, chest pain, or hemoptysis
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate pulmonary embolism

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可輔助處理穩定期腿部不適，但不能修復靜脈逆流或取代壓迫、傷口與血管治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能修復靜脈瓣膜、溶解血栓或取代壓迫與傷口照護。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 不針刺潰瘍、感染皮膚、脆弱曲張靜脈或疑似血栓區；先確認動脈循環與壓迫禁忌。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與血管科／傷口照護共同管理壓迫、潰瘍及介入治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support stable leg discomfort but cannot repair venous reflux or replace compression, wound, or vascular care.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot repair venous valves, dissolve thrombosis, or replace compression and wound care.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Do not needle ulcers, infected skin, fragile varicosities, or suspected thrombosis; arterial circulation and compression contraindications must be assessed.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage compression, ulcers, and intervention with vascular and wound-care teams.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.name_zh: 慢性發炎性脫髓鞘性多發神經病變
conditions.summary_zh: 免疫介導的周邊神經脫髓鞘疾病，通常呈進行或反覆的對稱近端與遠端無力、感覺異常及反射降低。
conditions.summary_en: An immune-mediated demyelinating peripheral neuropathy, typically causing progressive or relapsing symmetric proximal and distal weakness, sensory change, and reduced reflexes.
conditions.western_context_zh: 免疫介導的周邊神經脫髓鞘疾病，通常呈進行或反覆的對稱近端與遠端無力、感覺異常及反射降低。
conditions.western_context_en: An immune-mediated demyelinating peripheral neuropathy, typically causing progressive or relapsing symmetric proximal and distal weakness, sensory change, and reduced reflexes.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 免疫系統攻擊周邊神經髓鞘與神經根，造成傳導減慢或阻斷，長期可有軸突損傷。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Immune attack on peripheral myelin and nerve roots slows or blocks conduction and may eventually cause axonal injury.
conditions.etiology_zh: 免疫系統攻擊周邊神經髓鞘與神經根，造成傳導減慢或阻斷，長期可有軸突損傷。
conditions.etiology_en: Immune attack on peripheral myelin and nerve roots slows or blocks conduction and may eventually cause axonal injury.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 糖尿病或其他免疫相關共病
部分感染或免疫刺激後發病

risk_factors_en.factor: Onset after some infections or immune triggers

red_flags_zh.finding: 快速惡化無力、無法行走、吞嚥或呼吸困難
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診與神經科評估
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能有呼吸或延髓肌受累，且需排除急性神經病變

red_flags_zh.finding: 治療期間新發嚴重頭痛、胸痛、血栓症狀或腎功能異常
red_flags_zh.rationale: 免疫球蛋白等治療可能有嚴重併發症

red_flags_en.finding: Rapidly worsening weakness, inability to walk, or swallowing/breathing difficulty
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek immediate emergency and neurologic assessment
red_flags_en.rationale: Respiratory or bulbar muscles may be involved and an acute neuropathy must be excluded

red_flags_en.finding: New severe headache, chest pain, thrombotic symptoms, or renal abnormality during treatment
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Contact the treating team the same day
red_flags_en.rationale: Therapies such as immunoglobulin can have serious complications

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可輔助處理穩定期疼痛、疲勞或睡眠；不能抑制免疫性脫髓鞘或取代 IVIg、類固醇等治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能抑制免疫性脫髓鞘或取代疾病修飾治療。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 依感覺喪失、肌無力、跌倒風險與免疫抑制調整刺激；避免傷口與感染區。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與神經肌肉專科、復健與物理治療共同管理。
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: May support stable pain, fatigue, or sleep; it cannot suppress immune demyelination or replace IVIg, corticosteroids, or other treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot suppress immune demyelination or replace disease-modifying treatment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Adapt stimulation for sensory loss, weakness, fall risk, and immunosuppression; avoid wounds and infected areas.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with neuromuscular neurology, rehabilitation, and physical therapy.
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.

conditions.name_zh: 化療誘發周邊神經病變
conditions.summary_zh: 部分抗癌藥造成的周邊神經毒性，可引起手足麻木、刺痛、疼痛、無力、平衡或自主神經問題。
conditions.summary_en: Peripheral neurotoxicity from some anticancer drugs causing numbness, tingling, pain, weakness, balance problems, or autonomic symptoms in the hands and feet.
conditions.western_context_zh: 部分抗癌藥造成的周邊神經毒性，可引起手足麻木、刺痛、疼痛、無力、平衡或自主神經問題。
conditions.western_context_en: Peripheral neurotoxicity from some anticancer drugs causing numbness, tingling, pain, weakness, balance problems, or autonomic symptoms in the hands and feet.
conditions.western_pathology_zh: 化療可損傷感覺、運動或自主神經的軸突、神經元與支持細胞；累積劑量與藥物種類影響風險。
conditions.western_pathology_en: Chemotherapy can injure axons, neurons, and supporting cells in sensory, motor, or autonomic nerves; risk varies by agent and cumulative exposure.
conditions.etiology_zh: 化療可損傷感覺、運動或自主神經的軸突、神經元與支持細胞；累積劑量與藥物種類影響風險。
conditions.etiology_en: Chemotherapy can injure axons, neurons, and supporting cells in sensory, motor, or autonomic nerves; risk varies by agent and cumulative exposure.

risk_factors_zh.factor: 神經毒性化療藥與較高累積暴露
risk_factors_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

risk_factors_zh.factor: 既有糖尿病或周邊神經病變
risk_factors_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

risk_factors_zh.factor: 高齡或合併其他神經毒性暴露
risk_factors_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

risk_factors_en.factor: Neurotoxic chemotherapy and greater cumulative exposure
risk_factors_en.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment
NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

risk_factors_en.factor: Older age or concurrent neurotoxic exposure
risk_factors_en.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

red_flags_zh.finding: 新出現吞嚥、呼吸困難或快速惡化無力
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 立即急診並通知腫瘤團隊
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能有嚴重運動神經受累或其他急症
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

red_flags_zh.finding: 神經症狀影響走路、跌倒、精細動作或日常安全
red_flags_zh.recommended_action: 在下一次化療前立即通知腫瘤團隊
red_flags_zh.rationale: 可能需要調整抗癌治療以限制永久神經損傷
red_flags_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

red_flags_en.finding: New swallowing/breathing difficulty or rapidly worsening weakness
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Seek emergency care and notify oncology immediately
red_flags_en.rationale: May indicate severe motor-nerve involvement or another emergency
red_flags_en.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

red_flags_en.finding: Neuropathy affecting walking, falls, fine motor tasks, or daily safety
red_flags_en.recommended_action: Notify oncology promptly before the next chemotherapy dose
red_flags_en.rationale: Cancer treatment may need adjustment to limit permanent nerve injury
red_flags_en.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment

acupuncture_scope_zh.can_treat: 可在腫瘤團隊同意下輔助處理疼痛、麻刺與功能困擾；預防與療效證據仍有限，不可延誤劑量評估。
acupuncture_scope_zh.cannot_treat: 不能保證預防神經毒性，也不能取代腫瘤科的劑量調整。
acupuncture_scope_zh.precautions: 中性球低下、血小板低下、感染、皮膚破損或植入式管路附近避免針刺；感覺喪失處需防燙傷與出血。
acupuncture_scope_zh.co_management: 與腫瘤科、復健／物理治療及疼痛團隊共同管理並在每次化療前回報變化。
acupuncture_scope_zh.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment
acupuncture_scope_zh.note: 未核實可支持病種療效宣稱的針灸臨床指引；此欄僅界定輔助範圍與共同照護。

acupuncture_scope_en.can_treat: With oncology agreement, may support pain, tingling, and functional symptoms; prevention and efficacy evidence remain limited and dose assessment must not be delayed.
acupuncture_scope_en.cannot_treat: Cannot guarantee prevention of neurotoxicity or replace oncology dose adjustment.
acupuncture_scope_en.precautions: Avoid needling with neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, infection, broken skin, or near implanted lines; protect insensate areas from burns and bleeding.
acupuncture_scope_en.co_management: Co-manage with oncology, rehabilitation/physical therapy, and pain teams, reporting changes before each chemotherapy cycle.
acupuncture_scope_en.source: NCI — Nerve Problems (Peripheral Neuropathy) and Cancer Treatment
acupuncture_scope_en.note: No condition-specific acupuncture guideline supporting an efficacy claim was verified; this entry only defines adjunctive scope and co-management.
